field_descriptions.anchor_share: fraction of the coupled reference the anchored fleet asks for
field_descriptions.backstop_scarcity_credit: also credit that headroom in the scarcity margin
field_descriptions.boundary_book: an out-of-footprint neighbour modelled as an elastic counterparty
field_descriptions.fleet_truth_mode: true the fleet to trailing p95 output, or to registry installed capacity
field_descriptions.hydro_model: gas-anchored water value, or reservoir-opportunity from weekly levels
field_descriptions.import_backstop: offer demonstrated import headroom as elastic supply
field_descriptions.nuclear_avail_share_hi: anchor share when the fleet is fully available
field_descriptions.nuclear_avail_share_lo: anchor share when the nuclear fleet is at its crisis floor
field_descriptions.nuclear_bid_ref_ceiling: cap on anchor-lifted nuclear bids, as a multiple of the reference
field_descriptions.nuclear_srmc_floor: floor under nuclear bids (EUR/MWh) — France's off-peak position
field_descriptions.opportunity_anchor: which fleet re-bids in pass 2 against the coupled price
field_descriptions.peak_kappa: extra uplift at the day's demand peak
field_descriptions.ref_priced_exports: price exports over retained borders at the coupled reference
field_descriptions.scarcity_import_credit: credit available import capacity against the scarcity margin
field_descriptions.scarcity_kappa: how hard offers steepen once the margin is thin
field_descriptions.scarcity_threshold: supply margin below which offers start to steepen
field_descriptions.seasonal_drawdown: follow the seasonal reservoir drawdown cycle (Swedish north)
field_descriptions.spill_surplus_dryness: cv27 spill-risk gate: below this dryness the hydro offer chases the net-demand valley (0 = off)
field_descriptions.thermal_srmc_multiplier: premium on this zone's thermal running costs (Italy: 1.20)
field_descriptions.water_value_base: reservoir hydro's opportunity cost, as a multiple of gas SRMC
field_descriptions.water_value_span: how much the water value swings across the day's demand range

strategy_outside_the_profile.mechanism: The table is scoped to the EU-footprint product
strategy_outside_the_profile.note: Profiles apply ONLY on the coupled 39-zone path. The legacy single-zone and 5-zone SEE products force SEE_PROFILE, so for those the table below does not describe what was cleared.

When a day's coupled clear stays infeasible through the whole retry ladder, EVERY zone's fleet_truth_mode is forced to :p95 for that day and the day ships. So a published day can have been cleared with a different value of a column below.

Core-FBMC and other borders whose offered ATC misrepresents the real constraint are dropped per zone pair; two zones can share a profile and still be treated differently because of this. It also SHAPES BIDS: for an anchored zone, exports over a dropped border come back as a separate reference-priced demand block (anchor_export_mw), which is a bid mechanism keyed off the drop list and anchor state, not off any field.
strategy_outside_the_profile.where: the enriched network build, not the profile

strategy_outside_the_profile.note: Every :hydro/:nuclear anchored zone with no endogenous neighbour falls back to the DE_LU/NL average — a shared reference no column shows.

strategy_outside_the_profile.mechanism: Other zone-name-keyed treatment in the flow layer
strategy_outside_the_profile.note: The ex-ante flow rule treats the Nordic zones differently, and aggregate ENTSO-E border codes are remapped to a representative zone. Neither is a profile field.
strategy_outside_the_profile.where: flows_imports.jl (NORDIC_FLOW_ZONES D-7 recency) and the aggregate-border remap
